push.title: D 3-3 vs Goners12345 | You: 9.8 (2nd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
Ring the dinner bell, BellyTb1. A 9.8 and your 2nd best match performance of the season.

THE GOOD
+ 6 shots at Goners12345's goal. Shots are tickets to the goal lottery, and you bought a stack.
+ Man of the Match, your 18th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ On-ball actions 49, up from your usual 34. Keep stacking those bricks.
+ Tackle success 75%, up from your usual 41%. More of that, please and thank you.
+ That 9.8 sits as your 2nd best match performance of the season. Lovely stuff.

THE BAD
- 69% passing (27 of 39, down from your usual 76%). Here's the fix: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Bread and butter.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Here's how: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- 3 tackles won: -0.2. Practice makes permanent.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Climb to 60%+ and you're top quarter.

Five minutes of this: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: The ball is round, the game is long, and you're doing just fine.

I'm framing this one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Goners12345 | You: 9.2
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 9.2 against Goners12345. I'd give that a gold star if I could find my sticker book.

THE GOOD
+ 97% passing on 36 attempts, up from your usual 79%. Not a lot of wasted touches out there. Love it.
+ 4 shots at Goners12345's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). You see the field like a hawk sees a cornfield.
+ You and BellyTb1 were on the same page, same paragraph, same sentence.
+ 1.2 above your average. Look at you go.

THE BAD
- 2 of 4 shots on target. Quick fix: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Habits beat highlights.
- Tackle success 0%, down from your usual 25%. That's not you at your best, and we both know it.

Back-garden drill: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Stay hydrated and humble. - Coach Lasso
